description: This PHP source file fetches news feed data from an external URL, processes the items, and renders them using a Smarty template in the vtiger CRM environment. It sets up necessary variables and invokes methods to retrieve and display news on the home module of vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Vtiger_Feed_Parser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing RSS/Atom feeds, fetching items from a given URL.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine subclass used within vtiger CRM for rendering templates.

methods.name: vt_dofetch
methods.description: Fetches and parses the RSS/Atom feed from a specified URL with a timeout.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves the list of parsed feed items after fetching.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns data to Smarty template variables.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the specified template with assigned variables.
